ext_description.message: Adds material data sheets from MatWeb to an ANSYS Engineering Data library (XML) in one click. Not affiliated with MatWeb or ANSYS.

action_title.message: Material Converter – add this material to your ANSYS library

download_failed.message: The download could not be started

popup_empty_lead.message: This tab doesn't show a MatWeb material page.

popup_empty_step1_html.message: Open a material data sheet on matweb.com.

popup_nodata_lead.message: No property table was found on this MatWeb page.

popup_nodata_hint.message: Open a material's own data sheet, not a search result.

btn_export_one.message: Download all data as a separate XML

btn_export_one_title.message: Everything on the page, including hardness, composition and conditional values

props_none.message: No properties to transfer to ANSYS

warn_overview.message: Series overview page: the values are averages of the whole series, not of a specific grade.

warn_no_elasticity.message: No elasticity (E and ν): cannot be used for stress analysis in ANSYS.

lib_intro_html.message: Your materials for ANSYS. To add one, open a material page on MatWeb and click the Material Converter button in the toolbar.

auto_on_long.message: Updated automatically as materials are added or removed

sidebar_note_html.message: Select materials in the list and use Add to category to group them. Category files are not downloaded automatically: open a category and press Download category as ANSYS library to create a separate file named after it.

btn_download_selected_title.message: A separate ANSYS file containing only the selected materials

empty_step1_html.message: Open a material data sheet on matweb.com.

empty_step2_html.message: Click the Material Converter button in the toolbar.

empty_step3_html.message: Press Add to library. The material appears here and is written to the ANSYS file.

group_empty.message: This category is empty. Select materials under “All materials” and use “Add to category”.

setup_intro.message: Choose where the library file is saved and register it in ANSYS once. Every material you add afterwards is written to the same file.

setup_notice_html.message: For security reasons, browsers only let extensions write inside the Downloads folder, so the location is chosen as a subfolder of Downloads.

folder_placeholder.message: e.g. ANSYS/Materials — leave empty to use Downloads itself

auto_label.message: Update the main library file automatically when materials are added or removed (recommended; category files excluded)

path_line.message: The file will be saved to:

setup_s2_1_html.message: After saving the settings above, press Update now on the Materials tab to create the file.

setup_s2_2_html.message: In ANSYS Workbench, open Engineering Data and switch to the Engineering Data Sources view.

setup_s2_3_html.message: Use the … button in the Location column of the empty last row to select this file:

setup_s2_4.message: From then on, new materials are written to the same file; just refresh the library in ANSYS.

setup_s2_5_html.message: Categories are downloaded on demand — open a category and press Download category as ANSYS library — as separate files named after the category (e.g. Aluminium alloys.xml). They are never downloaded automatically. Add them to ANSYS the same way, as separate libraries.

setup_note_html.message: Menu names may differ slightly between ANSYS versions. For a one-time import you can also use File → Import Engineering Data.

setup_s3_html.message: Density, elasticity (E and ν), tensile yield and ultimate strength, compressive strengths, thermal expansion (with temperature table and reference temperature), specific heat, thermal conductivity and electrical resistivity — converted to SI units. Hardness, chemical composition and thickness-dependent values have no ANSYS equivalent; for those, use Download all data as a separate XML in the toolbar panel.

assign_count_html.message: 0 selected materials will be added to the chosen category.

name_label.message: Category name (also the name of its ANSYS library file)

open_on_matweb.message: Open the MatWeb page in a new tab

confirm_remove_one.message: Remove “$1” from the library (and from all categories)?

confirm_remove_many.message: Remove $1 materials from the library (and from all categories)?

group_stale.message: Downloaded file is out of date

group_stale_title.message: The category changed after the last download. Press “Download category as ANSYS library” to get the current version.

err_name_taken.message: A category with this name already exists.

toast_removed_from_group.message: $1 materials removed from “$2” (they stay in the library).

toast_group_created.message: Category “$1” created. Select materials under “All materials” and use “Add to category”.

toast_old_file_remains.message: The old file ($1) stays on disk; press “Download” to save it under the new name.

confirm_delete_group.message:
Delete the category “$1”?

The materials stay in the library. A previously downloaded file ($2) stays on disk.

toast_settings_saved.message: Settings saved. Press “Update now” on the Materials tab to create the file.

confirm_remove_many_one.message: Remove 1 material from the library (and from all categories)?

toast_removed_from_group_one.message: 1 material removed from “$1” (it stays in the library).

popup_read_failed.message: This page could not be read.

popup_read_failed_hint.message: Wait until the page has finished loading, then click the button again.
